Welcome to Itervox

Itervox lives in the menu bar: look for the I// icon at the top right of the screen. Its menu starts and stops your projects' daemons and opens their dashboards.

Can't see the icon? On a Mac with a notch, a full menu bar can hide it behind the notch. Hide some other menu bar items to make room. Opening Itervox again (from Finder, Spotlight or the Applications folder) always brings back a window.

Add your first project

Choose a project's WORKFLOW.md. No workflow yet? Run itervox init in the project's folder first.
